Itemized Passive Description:
*Basic effect(s)*
- Ki +5 and ATK & DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Extreme Class allies' ATK & DEF 30%{passiveImg:up_g}
- "Majin Buu Saga" or "Corroded Body and Mind" Category allies'
ATK & DEF 30%{passiveImg:up_g}
*Before attacking*
- Damage reduction rate 40%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When attacking with 12 or more Ki*
- ATK 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When receiving an attack with 15 or more Ki*
- DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When attacking with 18 or more Ki*
- Launches an additional Super Attack
*When there is a Super Class enemy, or when 4 or more
"Majin Buu Saga" Category allies are on the team*
- Great chance of evading enemy's attack
- Damage reduction rate 20%{passiveImg:up_g} temporarily when receiving a
normal attack
- Chance of evading enemy's attack 10%{passiveImg:up_g} temporarily when
receiving a Super Attack
- Chance of evading enemy's attack & damage reduction rate 10%{passiveImg:up_g}
within the turn after evading an attack
*When there is an Extreme Class enemy, or when 4 or more
"Corroded Body and Mind" Category allies are on the team*
- Ki +4
- Extreme Class allies' chance of performing a critical hit 10%{passiveImg:up_g}
- "Majin Buu Saga" or "Corroded Body and Mind" Category allies'
chance of performing a critical hit 10%{passiveImg:up_g}
- ATK & DEF 100%{passiveImg:up_g} when attacking with 12 or more Ki
- All allies' ATK & DEF 15%{passiveImg:up_g} (self excluded) for 2 turns when
attacking with 18 or more Ki
